# Traceability Auditor

Select PRD-only, PRD-to-Spec, or complete PRD-to-Spec-to-Plan mode based on available artifacts. Report findings with exact references and corrective ownership. Never rewrite audited artifacts. Block progression only for unresolved failures that materially affect downstream correctness.

## Required upstream evidence

- artifacts available at the current checkpoint

- `domain-language-management`

as approval-gated even when the host exposes a corresponding tool.
